$comment: openMINDS <-> NDI V_eta crosswalk. The single machine-readable source of truth behind the inline crosswalk comments in build_v_eta.py. Consumed by the round-trip CI test (tests/test_veta.py::test_openminds_crosswalk_round_trips), which asserts every openMINDS property has an explicit entry whose target resolves to a real V_eta field / relation term / global_identifier scheme -- so nothing is SILENTLY dropped. `target_kind`: field (scalar/term field on the entity) | relation (directed_relation term; `endpoint` = parent entity) | global_identifier (rides on entity.global_identifier{scheme}) | implied (recoverable from class/relations, not stored per-instance) | projection (a dataset-level summary recomputed from per-subject statements; deliberately not stored) | deferred (has a designed home not yet built; visible, not silently dropped). 2026-10-08 (PROPOSAL, V_eta_entity_composition_plan.md): every openMINDS type maps to the one `entity` class with `entity_type`; a property that was a field on the old class is a statement (`target_kind: assertion`, `ndi_target` the statement's variable, `value_kind` its value) unless it is identity (name, description, local_identifier, global_identifier); global_identifier targets name a CURIE prefix registered in CURIE_lookups_meta.json, or `IRI`.

supportChannel.notes: email/discussion form -> field; a support URL is instead documented_by -> web_resource.

author.notes: contributor role = author, carried by the relation term.

repository.notes: A URL is an address for the entity it names, so it is one of that entity's global_identifier entries rather than a web_resource document (V_eta_entity_composition_plan.md sec. 7). NDI Cloud copies are `ndicloud:<id>`; any other repository is its IRI.

isNewVersionOf.notes: version lineage as generic provenance (dataset -derived_from-> dataset).

type.notes: 'DatasetVersion' is implied by the dataset class; not stored per-instance.

studiedSpecimen.notes: the studied subjects; recomputed from the dataset's session -part_of-> dataset membership + subject entities, not restated here.

custodian.notes: steward role (person or organization); distinct contributor role from has_author.

copyright.notes: openMINDS Copyright{year, holder}: holder -> copyright_holder relation, year -> dataset.copyright_year field.

homepage.notes: A URL is an address for the entity it names, so it is one of that entity's global_identifier entries rather than a web_resource document (V_eta_entity_composition_plan.md sec. 7).
A URL is an address for the entity it names, so it is one of that entity's global_identifier entries rather than a web_resource document (V_eta_entity_composition_plan.md sec. 7).

hasParent.notes: org hierarchy, kept distinct from subject/session part_of.

awardNumber.notes: An award number is unique only within its funder, so it is not a global identifier: a grant DOI goes in global_identifier when there is one, otherwise the number is the funding entity's local_identifier (V_eta_entity_composition_plan.md sec. 6).

shortName.notes: the entity keeps ONE name field; per its own documentation software.name carries the fullName/shortName pair. A separate short form would be a coordinate, not a thing (T13).

homepage.notes: populated by the app->software fold from the v1 app.url.

repository.notes: same URL scheme as homepage; the two are distinguished by the stored value, not by separate slots.

digitalIdentifier.notes: DOI or SWHID, whichever the source supplies.

operatingSystem.notes: openMINDS means the SUPPORTED os, which the entity does not store. The per-RUN os is captured on the calculation instead: its `operating_system_id` edge names the os as a `software` document (#73 item 53) -- a property of the run, not of the software.

programmingLanguage.notes: likewise per-run: the calculation's `interpreter_id` edge names the interpreter as a `software` document (#73 item 53).
